name: Dungeon Matcher violet-gray dressed stone, a

tiles.name: wang_13
tiles.description: transparent background and Dungeon Matcher violet-gray dressed stone, a traditional side-view 2D platformer ledge made of LARGE intact rectangular slabs. Quiet broad matte planes, dark indigo joints, muted purple gray base, subtle lavender top-left light. Horizontal straight stone courses, sparse one-pixel chips only. Very low noise. No rounded cobblestones, no rubble, no dirt, no grass, no ornament, no cracks running through every slab. Side elevation, never isometric or a receding room floor. - wang_13

terrain_prompts.lower: Dungeon Matcher violet-gray dressed stone, a traditional side-view 2D platformer ledge made of LARGE intact rectangular slabs. Quiet broad matte planes, dark indigo joints, muted purple gray base, subtle lavender top-left light. Horizontal straight stone courses, sparse one-pixel chips only. Very low noise. No rounded cobblestones, no rubble, no dirt, no grass, no ornament, no cracks running through every slab. Side elevation, never isometric or a receding room floor.
terrain_prompts.upper: A very shallow flat horizontal walking surface on top of the stone ledge, one single row of wide rectangular violet-gray capstones. Thin restrained lit upper bevel, quiet broad top plane, dark narrow back seam. Constant level contact edge, no bumps or slopes. Only 1 or 2 clean lighting planes, no gritty texture.

pattern_system.description: 4×4 patterns with wildcards for flexible tile matching

pattern_layout.description: 4×4 grid where center 2×2 matches tile corners, outer ring uses wildcards

example.row_1: Wildcard + NW corner + NE corner + Wildcard
example.row_2: Wildcard + SW corner + SE corner + Wildcard

usage.description: Sample 4×4 terrain around tile position, encode as pattern key, lookup in cache

game_engines.name: Godot
game_engines.instructions: Import PNG as texture, create TileMap node, configure tile collision shapes

game_engines.name: Unity
game_engines.instructions: Import PNG, create Tilemap and Grid, configure tile collision with TilemapCollider2D

game_engines.name: Generic
game_engines.instructions: Use sprite_sheet data to extract individual tiles by bounding_box coordinates

usage.tile_placement: Use edge-based logic to select appropriate tiles based on neighboring terrain
